facts.fact: 阿拉里克眼看着阴影缠住塔拉辛、听见她的尖叫，也看见父亲在笑，他想救她却慢了。
facts.anchor: Alaric watched the shadows wrap around Talasyn. He heard her scream. He saw his father laugh.

facts.fact: 光织从塔拉辛体内涌出，震碎她腕上的束缚、劈开缠住她的午夜旋风，她自己先救下了自己。
facts.anchor: The Lightweave flowed out of her as though she were the heart of a Sever. It shattered the restraints around her wrists, it cut through the midnight whirlwind.

facts.fact: 塔拉辛一拳正中盖赫里斯的下巴，他后仰，后脑撞上椅背。
facts.anchor: Gaheris reeled back, the base of his skull colliding with the backrest.

facts.fact: 阿拉里克转身时，塔拉辛已被影门缠住躯干和脚踝，跪在他脚前。
facts.anchor: When Alaric turned around, Talasyn was kneeling at his feet, the Lightweave gone, the Shadowgate coiled around her torso and her ankles, trapping her in place.

facts.fact: 盖赫里斯在阿拉里克身后下令：为这个几乎断送帝国的女人复仇，动手。
facts.anchor: Before you kneels the woman who almost cost you your empire. Do it. Avenge yourself.

facts.fact: 阿拉里克警告父亲，若阿伦西娜·伊弗拉利斯今日死在此时，内纳瓦伦人会战到最后一人。
facts.anchor: if Alunsina Ivralis dies today, the Nenavarene will fight to the last soldier standing.

facts.fact: 束缚塔拉辛的暗链化作嵌合兽，那是只留在凯萨斯旗上的上古生物。
facts.anchor: The dark chains transmuted into chimeras, those long-gone creatures that now existed only on the Kesathese flag.

facts.fact: 嵌合兽把狮牙刺进盖赫里斯，在星光与黑曜石的漩涡中把他撕碎。
facts.anchor: They sank their leonine fangs into Gaheris and ripped him apart in a maelstrom of starlight and obsidian.
